mapper.insert: INSERT INTO physical_cluster (id, name, description, kubeconfig_base64_encrypted, status, kubernetes_version, node_count, gpu_count, last_sync_at, sync_message, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{description}, #{kubeconfigBase64Encrypted}, #{status}, #{kubernetesVersion}, #{nodeCount}, #{gpuCount}, #{lastSyncAt}, #{syncMessage}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE physical_cluster SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, kubeconfig_base64_encrypted = #{kubeconfigBase64Encrypted}, status = #{status}, kubernetes_version = #{kubernetesVersion}, node_count = #{nodeCount}, gpu_count = #{gpuCount}, last_sync_at = #{lastSyncAt}, sync_message = #{syncMessage}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM physical_cluster ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE physical_cluster SET status = 'RESETTING', kubernetes_version = NULL, node_count = 0, gpu_count = 0, last_sync_at = NULL, sync_message = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
